entities.summary: Loïc Courteau is a French former tennis player. Courteau has coached the French Fed Cup team in years past, as well as Amélie Mauresmo, the winner of two Grand Slams. He reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 93 in April 1983. He won one doubles title in his career, in 1986 at Buenos Aires partnering Horst Skoff.

entities.summary: Loïc Courteau is a French former tennis player. Courteau has coached the French Fed Cup team in years past, as well as Amélie Mauresmo, the winner of two Grand Slams. He reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 93 in April 1983. He won one doubles title in his career, in 1986 at Buenos Aires partnering Horst Skoff.
